title: Translate to New Language (Laplace Transform)
full_prompt:
Write a ManimGL script that visualizes how a complex signal can be decomposed into individual exponential components on the s-plane (Laplace domain). 

Your visualization should include:
1. A main 2D function graph representing a signal $f(t)$ which is constructed as a linear combination of complex exponentials: $f(t) = \sum w_i e^{s_i t}$.
2. An s-plane grid populated with small 'icon' graphs of $e^{st}$ placed at their corresponding complex coordinates $s = \sigma + i\omega$. Each icon should show a small bounding box, axes, and the real part of the exponential curve.
3. An introductory animation that fades in the main function graph, its axes, and the s-plane containing the grid of exponential icons.
4. A transition animation that dims (fades out) all exponential icons on the s-plane except for the specific key components ($s_i$) that actually compose the signal $f(t)$.
5. Text labels showing the weights ($w_i$) next to the highlighted key exponential icons on the s-plane.

Ensure you handle the layout cleanly, placing the main signal graph and the s-plane in a clear multi-panel arrangement. Use ManimGL's InteractiveScene or standard Scene with appropriate camera adjustments.

visual_techniques: Multi-panel layout (2D graph alongside s-plane grid)

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using standard Manim Community imports instead of ManimGL imports
common_failure_modes.note: The reference code relies on ManimGL's InteractiveScene and custom surface/mesh APIs. Mixing imports will cause syntax and runtime errors.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing implementation of the complex phase-to-color mapping function (z_to_color)
common_failure_modes.note: The 3D complex graph relies on custom HSL color mapping based on the phase of the complex output.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect positioning of the exponential icons on the s-plane
common_failure_modes.note: The icons must be mapped to the s-plane's coordinate system using s_plane.c2p(u, v) to align correctly with the grid.
